apply_patch_mae_model: apply ToMe token merging to a MAE VisionTransformer model by swapping its class and submodule classes
make_tome_class_transformer: create a ToMe-patched VisionTransformer subclass with modified forward and forward_features methods for MAE
apply_patch_trace_source: apply ToMe to a MAE model with source tracing enabled for token visualization
